title: FlipFlat accepts a foreign operation acknowledgement as success
description:
The command helper accepts any positive reply beginning with *, so a delayed status or malformed acknowledgement can make light/intensity requests report OK without confirming the requested operation. Repository simulator defines distinct operation acknowledgements. Validate echoed opcode/shape/payload and test stale/wrong-operation replies; no hardware execution. Fixed and reverified by the linked repair task; source and runtime limits remain recorded there.
